product_concept: A reliable turnover & property-operations kit for hosts with 1-5 listings: standardized cleaning/turnover checklists, a guest-ready house manual, and a supply-restock tracker — delivered so it won't break like the Canva templates hosts complain about.
product_format: Bundle: fill-in templates / scripts + calculator / spreadsheet + guide / checklist

transformation.from_state: From error-prone, ad-hoc turnovers and unclear house manuals
transformation.to_state: a standardized, reliable turnover system nothing falls through
transformation.promise: Every turnover done the same way, nothing forgotten, no broken templates.
transformation.core_problem: Airbnb hosts with 1-5 properties face a related cluster of problems around turnover & property operations — e.g. cleaner turnover coordination, supply restocking tracking, welcome book contents unclear.
transformation.desired_outcome: A shared outcome across member problems: Standardize every turnover. Never run out of guest supplies. Produce a house manual without tool failures.

promise: Every turnover done the same way, nothing forgotten, no broken templates.
price_rationale: Observed: Etsy host welcome-book/checklist bundles sell at ~$14-21+; this sits in the proven band.

jobs_to_be_done.statement: Achieve: A shared outcome across member problems: Standardize every turnover. Never run out of guest supplies. Produce a house manual without tool failures.
Resolve: Coordinating and standardizing cleaner turnover between guests is hard.
Resolve: Restocking supplies and consumables is easy to forget.
Resolve: Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.
